args.title: Fix duplication naming for long report names
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

When duplicating reports, ensure the '(copy)' suffix is added at the end of the name, even for names approaching the maximum length limit. The function implementing this is in `src/api/reports.ts` and should account for the suffix truncation.
